# Suite profile

**Generated by `tools/profile_suite.gd`. Do not hand-edit — regenerate.** Committed on purpose: `reports/` rolls at five blocks and this is a baseline meant to be compared against for much longer than that.

Work counts are exact and machine-independent; **wall-clock is the softer number** and will differ on your machine. Compare the counts across commits and the seconds only against themselves.
